steps.name: Choose one project
steps.goal: Reach the demo Home screen. Accept AI data consent if shown. Tap api-gateway folder in the top project rail. Do not open a session.
steps.done: The api-gateway folder is selected and its project subheader and sessions are visible.
expect: api-gateway. Showing only this folder. Show all

steps.name: Clear to all projects
steps.goal: Tap the selected api-gateway folder pill again once to clear the filter. Do not tap the composer project control.
steps.done: Sessions from multiple projects appear under separate project subheaders.

steps.name: Scope again
steps.goal: Tap the project subheader labelled api-gateway. Show only this folder. Do not tap the project pill for this step.
steps.done: Only api-gateway sessions remain under its header.
expect: api-gateway. Showing only this folder. Show all

steps.name: Clear no-project filter
steps.goal: Tap Chats without a project once to select it. Then tap that same tab again once to clear it.
steps.done: All projects are shown again with separate headers.
